AI_PROVIDER.description: Choose `openai` for GPT or `anthropic` for Claude.

AI_MODEL.description: Use a chat model available to your own API account. The default is `gpt-5-mini`.

ALLOWED_ORIGIN.description: Leave as `https://jhen-1993.github.io` so only this vocabulary site can call the Relay from a browser.

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Required only for GPT / OpenAI. Create it in the OpenAI API dashboard. Never paste it into the vocabulary site.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Required only for Claude / Anthropic. Create it in Anthropic Console. Never paste it into the vocabulary site.

RELAY_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: Optional but strongly recommended: a long personal password that protects this Relay URL.
